title: brief.md is the card, the brief as written, a blank line and the direct JITSO rules with the budget sentence
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, the v0.1.0 cut, rows 1 and 2: the launch appends JITSO's rules text to the end of brief.md
intent: A direct launch of a build with a budget appends the short JITSO rules to the end of brief.md: a blank line after the brief, then the four-line direct text (it says the human may be asked, and it names the card's budget as the ceiling). The end of the file is pinned by an anchored regex and the card and the brief by contains. The text of a build without a budget is pinned by launch/direct/no-budget-brief-md-ends-with-the-direct-rules.

regex:
## JITSO rules
Start other agent sessions only with the card's `launch:` line\. The card's budget is your ceiling: near it, stop and report\.
Load the card's skills before any other work\. You may ask the human\.
Leave `jitso/` and `\.jitso/` alone except your own draft in `\.jitso/drafts/`, and never run `jitso build save`\.
$
